completion.note: From the schema the #:schema directive names, so it works offline.

probes.says: TCP port the HTTP listener binds to.

hover.note: From the schema the #:schema directive names, so it works offline.

definition.note: Tombi's Cargo extension jumps from a workspace member to its Cargo.toml. even-better-toml offers no definition.

typeDefinition.note: Tombi jumps to the key's definition in the JSON Schema. even-better-toml offers no type definition.

references.note: Tombi's Cargo extension finds the members that inherit a workspace dependency. even-better-toml offers no references.

codeActions.note: Tombi's Cargo extension offers refactors such as inheriting a package field from the workspace. even-better-toml offers no code actions.

format.note: Tombi replaces its own copy of a document with the formatted text when it answers, so a second request on a file that needed formatting returns nothing. The probe uses a file already formatted.

rename.note: Gap: even-better-toml renames keys through Taplo's renameProvider. Tombi 1.11.3 declares no renameProvider.

probes.says: expected a value of type String, but found Integer

diagnostics.note: The Cargo.toml probe proves the catalog schema applies. Tombi ships the Cargo.toml and pyproject.toml schemas and their catalog inside its binary as tombi:// URLs, so this probe needs no network.
